desc: A wolf-like overlord creature of pure black shadow, cape of torn yellow wallpaper with gold trim, crown of fluorescent tubes, pale hollow eyes, horns of bent pipes, the most majestic and imposing design, slightly larger than other pets. Not a normal animal: a Backrooms anomaly creature, still small and pet-like, chibi 2-head-tall, right-facing 3/4 view, full body centered, clean pixel art, flat 3-tone shading, single dark outline, no ground shadow, no particles.
